crew.overview: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.
crew.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

crew.overview: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
crew.title: Thor: Ragnarok

crew.original_title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
crew.overview: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.
crew.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

crew.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
crew.title: Black Widow

crew.overview: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.
crew.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past

crew.overview: In 2035, where robots are commonplace and abide by the three laws of robotics, a technophobic cop investigates an apparent suicide. Suspecting that a robot may be responsible for the death, his investigation leads him to believe that humanity may be in danger.
crew.title: I, Robot

crew.overview: In stifling Edwardian London, Wendy Darling mesmerizes her brothers every night with bedtime tales of swordplay, swashbuckling and the fearsome Captain Hook. But the children become the heroes of an even greater story, when Peter Pan flies into their nursery one night and leads them over moonlit rooftops through a galaxy of stars and to the lush jungles of Neverland.
crew.title: Peter Pan

details.biography:
Hanzhi Tang is a Visual Effects Supervisor with over two decades of experience at Digital Domain, where he previously served as Digital Effects Supervisor and Head of Lighting. Throughout his career, he has contributed to more than 24 feature films, earning industry recognition including a Visual Effects Society Award nomination for Outstanding Created Environment in 2012, and a 2021 HPA Award for Outstanding Visual Effects—Theatrical Feature for Marvel's Black Widow.

Hanzhi supervised the visual effects for Marvel Studios' Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022), which received an Academy Award nomination for Best Visual Effects. Before that, he led VFX on Marvel's Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021), which also earned an Oscar nomination in the same category. His work on Wakanda Forever included a substantial portion of the film's climactic third act and beyond.

With a deep foundation in lighting and rendering, Hanzhi brings extensive on-set experience and expertise in digital head capture and virtual production. He has applied these skills to create highly realistic digital doubles, CG avatars, and even a fully CG commercial featuring 28 distinct characters for LG.

Hanzhi holds a Master of Science in Physics from Imperial College London, which underpins his ability to simulate real-world dynamics and optics in digital environments—key to his pursuit of realism in visual effects. In recognition of his significant contributions to the field, he was recently inducted into the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. He remains a key member of Digital Domain's global team of visual effects professionals.
details.name: Hanzhi Tang
